# Registers

The living records. Registers are the evidence that governance is operating rather than merely documented — and the first thing a regulator asks for.

| Template | Status | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [Data Asset Register](data-asset-register.md) | <span class="pill ready">Ready</span> | The catalogue of what data you hold, who owns it, how sensitive it is, and where it lives. Almost every other governance control depends on it. |

| [Processing & DPIA Log](processing-dpia-log.md) | <span class="pill ready">Ready</span> | The record of personal data processing activities and the impact assessments that cover them — the point where AI governance meets data protection law. |
